messages:
Ava: Quick heads-up — I'm pushing the 'modular-quicklabs' pack to the partner staging bucket now. This is the first end-to-end sample for our cloud partner onramp (Terraform modules + quickstart lab).
Ravi: Nice, what's included in v0.1?
Ava: Minimal: terraform module for infra (rg/vpc/gke-ish), a runtime overlay for Dedicated + Hosted examples, a sample infra README, and two smoke prompts for the LLM runtime. Also GH Actions for lint & basic smoke tests.
Sofia: Can we confirm the module naming? We had a short convo with legal about not using 'gke' directly in public module names.
Ava: Good call — naming convention is rwd-partner-quicklabs/compute-connector and rwd-partner-quicklabs/networking. README will say recommended providers and example configs.
Jamal: CI-Bot, can you run the tf fmt/tflint/tfsec checks once it's in staging?
CI-Bot: Requested: run pipeline for branch modular-quicklabs/v0.1 — tf-fmt -> tflint -> tfsec -> unit-smoke. ETA ~3m.
PartnerBot: New artifact published to staging bucket: gs://rwd-partner-staging/modular-quicklabs/v0.1. Links: https://staging.partners.redwood/example-quicklabs
Ravi: For the smoke tests — what's the acceptance criteria? Latency < 400ms for sample prompt? Or just basic generate + token sanity?
Ava: For v0.1 keep it simple: successful create + valid JSON answer schema for the sample prompt, and infra up/down without errors. Performance SLOs will be in v1.
Sofia: We should include a 'minimal-cost' profile for Dedicated (small instance + quantized model) and a 'developer-experience' profile (fast start, bigger instance) — add to README?
Ava: Yup, adding two profiles. I'll include example config blocks:
```
# minimal-cost profile
module "connector" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/rwd-partner-quicklabs.git//modules/compute-connector"
  instance_type = "rwd-cpu-small"
  model_variant = "llm-small-q4_0"
}
```
Ravi: How are we handling secrets and KMS? Need a note for Private customers with HSM/KMS flow.
Jamal: Add a subsection: KMS integration + env var examples. We can point to the Private deployment guide.
Sofia: Also add a short troubleshooting checklist for common terraform provider version mismatches (provider lockfile + terraform required_version). We hit that with FastCloud partners last week.
Ava: Good — will add provider constraints and a preflight script `scripts/preflight.sh` that checks terraform version, running `tfsec`, and confirms credentials.
Ravi: Can you drop a capsule test that runs an end-to-end deploy to a disposable project? Maybe use partner CI credits to avoid billing surprises.
CI-Bot: E2E job queued using partner-ci-credits (ephemeral infra) — job id #8421. Will post logs to /artifacts/8421/quicklabs-smoke.log
PartnerBot: E2E job #8421 succeeded: 1 deploy, 1 sample inference, teardown complete. Logs: https://staging.partners.redwood/logs/8421
Jamal: Great. Next: can we get an approval from partnerships for partner-facing copy? Need the one-pager to match the README.
Ava: @Sofia will draft the partner-facing one-pager. I'll open a PR for the README + profiles in 10m.
Sofia: I'll sync with partnerships on tone and security callouts. If approvals are green, we can schedule a partner demo next Tues.
Ravi: Minor nit — can we add a small diagram (PNG) of the network flow for the quicklab? That helps SIs.
Ava: Adding a 800x600 PNG to assets/arch.png.
Jamal: Thanks all. If anyone spots provider version issues in the logs, ping me and I'll update the lockfile. :thumbsup:
